items.html: And the reason for this is that the Mochin of Arich Anpin, too, are extended to him through clothing in the NHY of Atik within him. Now, Atik does not have two separate Partzufim, male and female; rather, the two of them are one Partzuf. Therefore, there, in Aba and Ima, which are two Partzufim, two phases of Mochin entered: one in the NHY of Aba, and one in the NHY of Ima. But here, since the male and female of Atik are all one Partzuf, there are only three Mochin alone in Arich Anpin. Hence he has only one Daat, in which there are the five Hassadim from the side of the male, the name MA in it, and the five Gevurot from the side of the female, the name BON in it, for it is all one phase.
